name: kinetic-text
title: Kinetic Text
description: Letters swell in weight around a pointer that glides along the headline: the touched letter goes black-heavy with an outline, its neighbours less, each change easing over 0.4 s.

moworks.author: magicui

options.path: [[t, letter], ...] relative to `at` (sweep left to right and back over 3 s)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Needs a variable font (Inter, Roboto Flex...). Upstream reacts to the mouse; here `path` lists [time s, letter index] points the pointer passes (linear between them, -1 = off the word).
moworks.titleVi: Nét chữ phình theo con trỏ lướt
